questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No right turn.
Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
Curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what traffic laws they must follow. You must drive in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: When a bicyclist is making a left turn:

options.text: They may use the left lane.
They may cut through all lanes.
They may wait on the side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: They may use the left lane.
questions.explanation: Bicyclists ride with traffic on the road. You should expect to see a bicyclist in the left lane when turning left.

questions.question: Broken yellow lines are used on streets and highways to:

options.text: Indicate no passing zones.
Separate lanes of traffic moving in the same direction.
Separate lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Separate lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Broken lines mean you can pass when it is safe.

questions.question: When driving on the highway, looking far ahead of your vehicle:

options.text: Helps you keep up with traffic.
Reduces the need for last-minute braking or turning.
Allows you to spot upcoming police officers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduces the need for last-minute braking or turning.
questions.explanation: Watch the road far ahead to avoid sudden braking or turning. Looking ahead lets you prepare to stop or change lanes safely. This saves fuel and helps traffic flow smoothly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is coming. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop Sign Ahead.
Side Road.
Railroad Warning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop Sign Ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up.

questions.question: In which situation should your wheels not be pointed straight ahead?

options.text: When waiting to make a left turn at a traffic light.
When parked on a hill or sloping driveway.
When parked on the side of a level roadway where there is no curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: When parked on a hill or sloping driveway.
questions.explanation: When waiting to turn left, keep your wheels straight. If hit from behind, you will not slide into oncoming traffic. On a hill or slope, turn your wheels so the car will not roll into traffic if the brakes fail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed limit.
The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
You must not travel below the speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the highest speed allowed on this road. You can drive slower based on road conditions, but you cannot drive faster than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Motorist services.
Construction and maintenance.
Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.correctAnswerText: Motorist services.
questions.explanation: Blue signs show motorist services. They tell you where to find rest areas, food, gas, or hospitals.

questions.question: When you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection:

options.text: Stop before crossing the intersection.
Slow down and proceed with caution.
Wait for a green light before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down, look for cross traffic, and continue carefully.

questions.question: When changing lanes, what should you do?

options.text: Only use the rearview mirror.
Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.
Only use the left side mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.
questions.explanation: Look over your shoulder to check for vehicles in your blind spot. Check several times before changing lanes. Watch both the traffic in front of you and the traffic in the lane next to you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Curves ahead.
A divided highway is starting.
A divided highway is ending.

questions.correctAnswerText: A divided highway is ending.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead. Be ready to change lanes or shift your position.

questions.question: What does a flashing red traffic light at an intersection mean?

options.text: It means the same thing as a yield sign.
The light is about to turn green.
It means the same thing as a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must stop completely. Yield to other traffic and pedestrians. Go only when it is safe. This is the same as a stop sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield the right-of-way.
No passing zone.
Fewer lanes ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: How should you make a right turn?

options.text: Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the center before turning.
Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
Start near the right curb, then move toward the middle of the street before turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
questions.explanation: Signal before turning to warn other drivers. Slow down and stay as close to the right curb as possible when approaching the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No passing zone.
Right turn allowed on red.
Yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: No passing zone.
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks where a no passing zone begins.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: You can pass from the lane with the solid yellow line.
No one can pass from either direction.
You can pass from the lane with the broken yellow line.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass from the lane with the broken yellow line.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line means you can cross it to pass. A solid yellow line means you cannot cross it to pass. When they are together, only traffic in the lane with the broken line may pass.

questions.question: If you have a green light but traffic blocks the intersection, what should you do?

options.text: Turn left and find another route.
Wait until traffic clears before entering the intersection.
Follow other vehicles into the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until traffic clears before entering the intersection.
questions.explanation: Do not enter the intersection if other vehicles are blocking the way, even if your light is green. If you get stuck in the intersection when the light turns red, you will block traffic. You can get a ticket for this.

questions.question: At dawn, dusk, or in rain or snow, what is the best way to help other drivers see you?

options.text: Turn up the dashboard lights.
Turn on your parking lights.
Turn on your headlights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your headlights.
questions.explanation: Use your headlights whenever it is hard to see other vehicles or hard for other drivers to see you. Use low beam headlights whenever you use your windshield wipers because of weather.

questions.question: What is the term for the amount of alcohol in a person's blood?

options.text: Implied consent (IC).
Blood alcohol concentration (BAC).
Rate of alcohol consumption (RAC).

questions.correctAnswerText: Blood alcohol concentration (BAC).
questions.explanation: Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) measures the percentage of alcohol in the blood. A higher BAC number means a person is more impaired.

questions.question: You see a steady yellow traffic light ahead and have not entered the intersection yet. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to cross before the red light.
Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Stop safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop safely.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means you should prepare to stop. If you are already in the intersection, drive through it quickly and safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ends ahead.
The road splits. You must turn either right or left.
A four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road splits. You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road splits into two directions. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What is one result of driving too fast?

options.text: It does not increase the risk of a crash.
It helps you react faster to dangers.
It causes drivers to make unsafe decisions.

questions.correctAnswerText: It causes drivers to make unsafe decisions.
questions.explanation: Speeding is a major cause of crashes. It does not save time and often leads to unsafe decisions while driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Winding road
Loose gravel
The road is slippery when wet

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road can be slippery when wet. Drive slowly and carefully on this road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.
A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road will curve sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: You are parking downhill on a two-way road with no curb. Which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Straight ahead
Right, toward the side of the road
Left, toward the center of the road

questions.correctAnswerText: Right, toward the side of the road
questions.explanation: When parking downhill, turn your wheels toward the edge of the road. This keeps your car from rolling into traffic if the brakes fail. When parking uphill on a road with a curb, turn your wheels toward the center instead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking reserved for people with disabilities.
Slow-moving vehicle.
No U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking reserved for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disability parking permits.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?

options.text: Service sign.
Regulatory sign.
Warning sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warning sign.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to dangers ahead, such as sharp turns, steep hills, or other hazards that need your attention.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not enter.
Roundabout ahead.
No U-turns allowed.

questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turns allowed.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers the rules they must follow. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn in this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A construction worker with a flag is ahead.
A police officer is ahead.
A parking attendant is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A construction worker with a flag is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear bright orange, yellow, or yellow-green clothing. They use paddles and flags to direct traffic and let construction vehicles cross safely.
